name: Motion Lab
description: Live readings from your phone's accelerometer, gyroscope, orientation and compass, with a spirit level.

store.tagline: Your phone's motion sensors, live: compass, spirit level, accelerometer and gyroscope.
store.description:
Motion Lab turns your phone's built-in sensors into a live dashboard. A single dial works as both a compass and a spirit level: the ring turns with your heading, and the bubble drifts as you tilt the phone, turning green when it sits level. Below it, cards show the accelerometer, gyroscope, device orientation and compass heading as they change, with the update rate and total g-force.

Use it to level a shelf or a picture frame, find north, check that a phone's sensors work, or just watch what your phone feels as it moves.

Readings run only while Motion Lab is on screen, and you can pause them at any time. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere: the numbers stay on your device. On iPhone, tap Start and allow motion access. Most computers have no motion sensors, so open Motion Lab on your phone to see live readings.
